method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Housing Act 1980 (WA), compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 37092, retrieved 2026-09-07; compilation table to the Public Health (Consequential Provisions) Act 2016, Reprint 4 as at 2 Sep 2016 the last reprint listed), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_37092.txt; no regulations or gazetted determinations deposited: eligibility conditions (s 5(2)), the Minister's limits (ss 34, 40, 46(2)(a)), standard rates of interest (ss 33(4), 42(1)) and rent determinations (s 30) are inputs

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: s 5(2), (3), s 15(1), ss 28, 30, 31(1)-(2), 32, 33(1), (6), 34(1), 35, 36(1), 37, 38(1), (3), 40(1), 41(1), 42(3), 46(1), (2)(a), 47, 60(1)(a)-(b), 68, 72, 73. Not encoded: the Authority's constitution, staff and delegation (Part II), land acquisition, development and non-house leasing and sale (Part III Divs 1-2), Commonwealth arrangements and State loan agreements (Part V) save the borrower's position, community facilities (s 61), Aboriginal housing management agreements (Part VA), funds and borrowing (ss 62-65), regulations (ss 70-71), transitional provisions (Part IX). Keystart is not named in the Act; its lending policy is an input.
seat: the low-income home buyer (Keystart, shared equity) and public housing tenant
